crobus9: Felix Crobus arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a frozen apple and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Felix Crobus held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one.
Felix Crobus splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.
The relief column arrived early. Felix Crobus made room in the shelter by moving everything except the men already asleep.
Felix Crobus lent Leopold Wihanholtzha a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.

Felix Crobus was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-S11. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Anselm Ryan of the Hegemony (@superb.ryan). Felix Crobus was killed on watch at R-S11. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Anselm Ryan of the Hegemony (@superb.ryan).
Valentin Crobus put a frozen apple beside the bunk. Someone who had known Felix Crobus helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Valentin Crobus and Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Valentin Crobus answered to number 414. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-S11 with the rations. Valentin Crobus ate while listening to the revised orders.
Valentin Crobus fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Dorian "Whistle" Aversa was grazed. Valentin Crobus ate breakfast without a word.
Valentin Crobus tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Valentin Crobus tried to remember the price of a loaf in Lindenbruck. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Valentin Crobus brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.

A single shot from across the wire hit Valentin Crobus in the thigh at R-S11. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Edmund "Smokes" Acakostic of the Hegemony (@acakostic11). Valentin Crobus was killed at R-S11 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Edmund "Smokes" Acakostic of the Hegemony (@acakostic11).
Benedikt Crobus came to the front because his older brother Valentin Crobus never came home. He carries a frozen apple.
Benedikt Crobus began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
A mouse ran across Benedikt's boot and into a biscuit tin. He let it stay. It was the only visitor all day.
damnitsamir: Henrik Damnitsamir walked into R-R1 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Henrik Damnitsamir helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Henrik Damnitsamir cut Zeno Hammerthyste's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. Grey Mill has been won. Henrik Damnitsamir listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Henrik Damnitsamir pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Henrik Damnitsamir accepted promotion to Lance Corporal. Later, he practised giving the morning orders quietly enough not to wake the dugout.
Henrik Damnitsamir fixed the strap on Konrad "Bones" Dominushospe's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Henrik Damnitsamir dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.

Henrik Damnitsamir had just lit a cigarette at R-R1 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Marek "Button" Angrypenguin of the Concord (@angrypenguin1000).
Henrik Damnitsamir came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
Henrik spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath Grey Mill someone else was digging too.
dustinviper11: Karel Dustinviper arrived on Day 11 as a replacement. The men in N-F5 had been fighting for 11 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Karel Dustinviper spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Emil "Lucky" Jarvisben (Hegemony) watched Karel Dustinviper (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Calvary Farm, and held fire until both were gone.
Karel Dustinviper saved the last of the sugar for Zeno "Brick" Peter's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Brick's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Karel Dustinviper of the Concord and Ivo Racoon of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at Blackwater Canal for a week. Both trenches keep score.

At N-F5 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Karel Dustinviper turned around and took a shovel blow. Yann Meter of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Yann Meter of the Hegemony (@xen0meter).

A bullet went through Karel Dustinviper's upper arm at N-F5 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Ivo Tongantui of the Hegemony (@tongantui). Karel Dustinviper asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Benedikt "Lucky" Dustinviper arrived carrying the family name of Karel Dustinviper. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Benedikt said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
gage_fisher01: Dietrich Fisher joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

The Hegemony raiders came over at R-R1 in the middle of the night. Dietrich Fisher met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Gustav Marksebastio of the Hegemony (@marksebastion).
Walter Fisher took the same post at R-R1 where Dietrich Fisher stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

The whole squad at R-R1 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Walter Fisher's bullet that found Cyril Pyyro, grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Fisher. Walter Fisher read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Walter Fisher stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Walter Fisher tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Saint-Lune. Every version sounded like the ration bell. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Fisher. Walter Fisher read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Walter Fisher changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Fisher. Walter Fisher read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Walter Fisher was made Lance Corporal. He celebrated by sleeping four hours in a row.

Shell splinters hit Walter Fisher in the back and legs at R-R1. The bearers carried him face down on the stretcher. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Fisher. Walter Fisher read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Fisher drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. The mail bag came up with the soup. There was a letter for Walter Fisher, and the soup went cold while Walter Fisher read it.
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Walter Fisher. He died on the stretcher before morning.
Edmund "Brick" Fisher asked about Walter Fisher on arriving at R-R1. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Edmund waited for that to change. When it did, Edmund "Doc" Falloutvam was badly wounded. Edmund fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Walter Aquaman, now grazed. Edmund got a letter from a friend still at home. It was mostly about a girl and a horse, and Edmund could not tell which one mattered.
joaotomas1122: Marek Joaotomas arrived at R-S5 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Marek Joaotomas studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked R-S5 in the dark to learn it by heart.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Marek Joaotomas watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A bullet hit Marek Joaotomas's belt buckle at R-S5 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Nils "Bones" Martinvajda of the Hegemony (@martinvajda.21). Marek Joaotomas got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 503. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-S5. Marek Joaotomas has learned to walk bent double.

A single shot from across the wire hit Marek Joaotomas in the thigh at R-S5. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Konrad Izu of the Hegemony (@arch_izu). Marek Joaotomas was hit at R-S5 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Konrad Izu of the Hegemony (@arch_izu).
Another member of the House of Joaotomas reached the line: Yann Joaotomas. He asked where Marek Joaotomas had slept, then chose a different corner.
Yann Joaotomas saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Ulrich "Bones" Beto, grazed. Yann Joaotomas cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Yann Joaotomas and Teodor "Button" Magtyu have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
Yann Joaotomas reached up to fix a sandbag at R-S5 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Emil Icespiceynod of the Hegemony (@icespiceynoddlrs).
Yann Joaotomas was hit in the hip at R-S5. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps).
A stretcher was all Yann ever had. He recovered on it anyway, mostly out of stubbornness.
kolor_o_vo: The sergeant gave Norbert Kolor a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 11 or any other.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Norbert Kolor was waiting. Nils "Lucky" Nguyen was grazed.
A round went through the rim of Norbert Kolor's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Dietrich Dagata of the Concord (@anthony.dagata).
Norbert Kolor's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

A bullet went into Norbert Kolor's chest just under the heart at U-F2. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Roland "Button" Lahetta of the Concord (@cody_lahetta). Norbert Kolor looked over the parapet at U-F2 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Roland "Button" Lahetta of the Concord (@cody_lahetta).
A letter came with Ulrich Kolor: "I am Norbert Kolor's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Ulrich Kolor was on watch at U-F2 when the night raid hit. The men found Ulrich Kolor at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Karel Nguyen of the Concord (@khoi_nguyen6789).
Quentin Kolor came to the front because his older brother Ulrich Kolor never came home. He carries a child's drawing of a horse.
Quentin Kolor saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
Quentin saw Casimir "Ghost" Alive freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Quentin said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
le_photographe_fous: Ivo Fous came up the line with a frozen apple and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Ivo Fous carried three men out of R-S12 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not. A letter from home found Ivo Fous before the night shift. Ivo Fous folded it small and kept it close.

Ivo Fous saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. A letter from home found Ivo Fous before the night shift. Ivo Fous folded it small and kept it close.
New laces made Ivo Fous's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.

Ivo Fous hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. A letter from home found Ivo Fous before the night shift. Ivo Fous folded it small and kept it close.

Ivo Fous jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr. The Concord medics will be busy. (@kelvincornbread) In the dark of the Concord trench Ivo Fous hit Teodor Deanc with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@deanc_67) Ivo Fous went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Ivo Fous folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside. A letter from home found Ivo Fous before the night shift. Ivo Fous folded it small and kept it close.

Ivo Fous sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour. The clerk counted the names twice. Ivo Fous is number 429 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Ivo Fous helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

The relief column arrived early. Ivo Fous made room in the shelter by moving everything except the men already asleep. A letter from home found Ivo Fous before the night shift. Ivo Fous folded it small and kept it close.

An officer heard about the singing and forbade it. Tonight Ivo Fous only whistled the first bar. Across the wire, someone whistled the last. A letter from home found Ivo Fous before the night shift. Ivo Fous folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit Ivo Fous in the neck at R-S12. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Ivo Fous. Nobody pretends that is not how it works. Ivo Fous died in bed just before dawn. The orderly closed his eyes and wrote the time on the chart.
A letter came with Otto "Shadow" Fous: "I am Ivo Fous's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Otto "Shadow" Fous added a leak above the man's head in pencil. A letter from home found Otto "Shadow" Fous before the night shift. Otto "Shadow" Fous folded it small and kept it close.

Otto "Shadow" Fous made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Otto "Shadow" Fous crawled the last yards. The bearers set Otto "Shadow" Fous's stretcher down under a tarp and promised to come back. They came back with another man.

Otto "Shadow" Fous spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped. The letter for Otto "Shadow" Fous asked if the food was good. Otto "Shadow" Fous wrote back that it was. That was a lie, but a kind one.

The field hospital let Otto go. He came back up the line on foot because the truck would not wait. The letter for Otto had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Otto dried it by the stove, page by page. Now serving as a sapper, Otto discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
macwigger2214: They issued Emil "Lucky" Macwigger a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a book with the last pages torn out in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Emil "Lucky" Macwigger held the mirror while Jakub Faulerhund shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. A letter from home reached Emil "Lucky" Macwigger before dusk. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Rain washed the chalk names from the trench signs. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger spent the evening directing strangers past the same junction. A letter from home reached Emil "Lucky" Macwigger before dusk. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger read it twice and slept a little easier.

A stretcher party needed the passage. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger backed into a recess with an ammunition box and stayed there until the last bearer passed. A letter from home reached Emil "Lucky" Macwigger before dusk. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger read it twice and slept a little easier.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Emil "Lucky" Macwigger. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. A letter from home reached Emil "Lucky" Macwigger before dusk. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil "Lucky" Macwigger lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified. A letter from home reached Emil "Lucky" Macwigger before dusk. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil "Lucky" Macwigger threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Bastian "Lucky" Vpy was down and screaming for a medic. (@v01py) The Concord sentry, Felix Topekeno, shouted once. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@topekeno) Victory at Blackwater Canal. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. A letter from home reached Emil "Lucky" Macwigger before dusk. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger read it twice and slept a little easier.

A shell hit the latrine at R-S9. Nobody was hurt. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger says it was the best day of the war. A letter from home reached Emil "Lucky" Macwigger before dusk. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger read it twice and slept a little easier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger is number 360. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Emil "Lucky" Macwigger borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Tobias Hill was grazed. A letter from home reached Emil "Lucky" Macwigger before dusk. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger read it twice and slept a little easier.

The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger ate two helpings anyway. A letter from home reached Emil "Lucky" Macwigger before dusk. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger was hit in the foot through his boot at R-S9. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. A letter from home reached Emil "Lucky" Macwigger before dusk. Emil "Lucky" Macwigger read it twice and slept a little easier.
Emil "Lucky" Macwigger did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
The papers connected Pavel Macwigger to Emil "Lucky" Macwigger. The men took longer to learn Pavel Macwigger's own habits, but they made the effort.

Pavel Macwigger went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. The letter for Pavel Macwigger ended with 'come home soon'. Pavel Macwigger read the last line more than the rest.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Gustav Eddie stood up to sing louder, and Pavel Macwigger fired. Gustav Eddie was badly wounded. The singing stopped.

Pavel got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces. Pavel unfolded the letter carefully. A dried leaf fell out, and Pavel put it in a pocket without a word.
makinekivanc: Nils Makinekivanc told the sergeant he was a blacksmith. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
Nils Makinekivanc's hands still remember being a blacksmith's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.

Nils Makinekivanc saw Valentin Zle freeze on the fire step at the Hanging Bridge. Nils said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Nils Makinekivanc folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Jonas Miked and Nils Makinekivanc carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
The relief reached R-F8 without Nils Makinekivanc. His name was added to a list the corporal kept separate from the dead.

Nils Makinekivanc returned by a trench nobody thought passable. He asked for water before explaining how little of it was still a trench. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F8. Nils Makinekivanc has learned to walk bent double.

Nils Makinekivanc lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified. A letter from home found Nils Makinekivanc before the night shift. Nils Makinekivanc folded it small and kept it close.
Nils Makinekivanc brought back a wounded man and a lost machine gun from the Sunken Road in one trip. He is Lance Corporal now.

Nils Makinekivanc caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. A letter from home found Nils Makinekivanc before the night shift. Nils Makinekivanc folded it small and kept it close.

Nils Makinekivanc offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last. A letter from home found Nils Makinekivanc before the night shift. Nils Makinekivanc folded it small and kept it close.

The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Nils Makinekivanc read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed. A letter from home found Nils Makinekivanc before the night shift. Nils Makinekivanc folded it small and kept it close.

Frost made each footprint distinct. Nils Makinekivanc followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it. A letter from home found Nils Makinekivanc before the night shift. Nils Makinekivanc folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Nils Makinekivanc is number 117 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-F8, Nils Makinekivanc listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Nils Makinekivanc saved the last of the sugar for Edmund Crack's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Edmund's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Nils Makinekivanc and Jonas Miked carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Nils Makinekivanc ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Nils Makinekivanc found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Nils Makinekivanc set a charge under the enemy listening post. Then he waited all night for an order that did not come.
A supply man offered Nils Makinekivanc a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.

Nils felt a hard tug at his hip at R-F8. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Bastian Lover of the Hegemony (@lemonade_lover393).
miki.y_flex: Hugo Flex joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

A bullet hit Hugo Flex's belt buckle at U-F14 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Walter "Bones" Marko of the Hegemony (@albert_marko_). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Hugo Flex read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The medics cleaned Hugo Flex's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at U-F14.

Hugo Flex was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at U-F14. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Quentin Caeleboldake of the Hegemony (@caeleboldaker).

Hugo Flex was hit twice at U-F14, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Bram Jackalaaltos of the Hegemony (@jackalaaltosfritz). Hugo Flex was hit at U-F14 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Bram Jackalaaltos of the Hegemony (@jackalaaltosfritz).
Marek "Saint" Flex came to the front because his uncle Hugo Flex never came home. He carries a dented harmonica.

Marek "Saint" Flex took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at U-F14, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Walter "Bones" Marko of the Hegemony (@albert_marko_).
Someone moved Marek "Saint" Flex's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
There was never a bed for Marek "Saint" Flex, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to U-F14 on his own feet.
Marek cleaned every part of the machine gun with an old toothbrush. The gun was happier, and so was the crew.
nekroticdekay: They issued Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a tin of tobacco in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached Q-F2 with the rations. Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka ate while listening to the revised orders.

Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka (Concord) watched Dietrich "Tin" King (Hegemony) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Brickworks, and held fire until both were gone.
Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka pulled Otto Wahoocardboa out of a flooded shell hole at the Bone Quarry. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka of the Concord and Emil Czucha of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at Sorrow Copse for a week. Both trenches keep score.
Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka and Otto "Bones" Lauronendani have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At Q-F2 they left Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Tobias Stnmz of the Hegemony (@thomas.stnmz).
Bastian Nekroticdeka had heard about Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka's courage. At Q-F2, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Bastian Nekroticdeka (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Walter "Bones" Marko (Hegemony) at the Ossuary Wood. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Marek Jeanms, gravely wounded. Bastian cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
philnowak: The old hands of V-F7 have been here since Day 1. Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak has been here since Day 14. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Anselm Deakins was grazed.

Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Felix Type. The Concord medics will be busy. (@normal_type) Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Arno Saigearmstro was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@saigearmstro) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak read it while the kettle boiled.

Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter for Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak came all the way from home in nine days. Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak counted them on the envelope.

Ulrich fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Anselm Godden was badly wounded trying to cross it. The letter for Ulrich had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Ulrich dried it by the stove, page by page.
ringwraith1212: Edmund Ringwraith took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Edmund Ringwraith put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.

Shrapnel at the Ossuary Wood. Edmund Ringwraith walked to the medics on his own feet and asked for a cigarette before the stitches. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Edmund Ringwraith helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
The medics cleaned Edmund Ringwraith's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F4.
The men have learned that Edmund Ringwraith tells terrible jokes. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.
Quentin Caden of the Concord and Edmund Ringwraith of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Calvary Farm now wait for it before they sleep.

Edmund Ringwraith was hit twice at S-F4, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Quentin Underthrone of the Concord (@underthrone99). Edmund Ringwraith was hit at S-F4 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Quentin Underthrone of the Concord (@underthrone99).
Albin "Tin" Ringwraith arrived carrying the family name of Edmund Ringwraith. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Albin "Tin" Ringwraith wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Albin "Tin" Ringwraith held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Albin "Tin" Ringwraith answered to number 242. Grey Mill has been won. Albin "Tin" Ringwraith listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Albin "Tin" Ringwraith tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F4 and grazed Albin "Tin" Ringwraith's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Emil Majormalprac of the Concord (@majormalpractice_626).
The wound on Albin "Tin" Ringwraith's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.

Albin "Tin" Ringwraith felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F4. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Leopold Falloutcat of the Concord (@falloutcat123).
Albin "Tin" Ringwraith's bandage soaked through twice in one night. The medic called the bearers before morning.
There was never a bed for Albin "Tin" Ringwraith, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F4 on his own feet.
A white dog ran between the lines at the Drowned Farm. Albin (Hegemony) and Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic (Concord) both whistled for it. It chose neither.
rlhaight: Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight was a postman in Tannenfeld until the posters went up. He came to T-F6 with a bullet that missed him, and within a day the whole squad knew that he is always the first one awake.

Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight gave Viktor Haber the last match in the trench. Viktor used it to light a candle so that Saint could finish a letter. Grey Mill has been won. Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
Wiring party. Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at T-F6, and everyone came back.
The artist tried again while Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Across the wire at the Sunken Road, Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Lucien Knoppu of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'
Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare.
Henrik wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
santiago.luissantos: The old hands of R-F2 have been here since Day 1. Hugo Luissantos has been here since Day 5. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Hugo Luissantos began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Luissantos. Hugo Luissantos read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F2, Hugo Luissantos listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Otto Geronimoleys taught Hugo Luissantos to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Luissantos. Hugo Luissantos read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The reply to Hugo Luissantos's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Hugo Luissantos sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
A bullet grazed Hugo Luissantos's ribs at R-F2. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Gustav "Brick" Floooring of the Hegemony (@carpet.floooring).

Hugo Luissantos no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Hugo Luissantos watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Hugo Luissantos asked the dugout for advice on the next move. Three men disagreed so fiercely that a second board had to be drawn. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Hugo Luissantos answered to number 334. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Hugo Luissantos watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A round went through the rim of Hugo Luissantos's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Teodor Bangarang of the Hegemony (@bangarang_._._).
Hugo Luissantos's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F2 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Hugo Luissantos received a letter announcing checkmate. The dugout insists the position was copied incorrectly. He has written back asking for another game.
Splinters from a shell rained down on R-F2. Hugo Luissantos took one in the shoulder and had it dug out right there on the fire step.
Hugo Luissantos rejoined the squad at R-F2. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

A round came through the loophole Hugo Luissantos was watching at R-F2 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep of the Hegemony (@1gtbeep). The bearers reached Hugo Luissantos at R-F2 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep of the Hegemony (@1gtbeep).
Another member of the House of Luissantos reached the line: Isidor Luissantos. He asked where Hugo Luissantos had slept, then chose a different corner.
Isidor saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
screaming_bloody_art: Nobody asked Cyril Art why he came. Nobody in R-R3 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Cyril Art raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R3. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Tobias Htmmci of the Concord (@htmmci). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Cyril Art watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Cyril Art stopped talking around midday. The medic took one look and called for a stretcher. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Cyril Art during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
There was never a bed for Cyril Art, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-R3 on his own feet.
Cyril Art made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Cyril Art censored the men's letters tonight. He crossed out the place names and left in all the love.
Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta of the Concord spotted Cyril Art of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Hill 304. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Cyril Art discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list.
Cyril Art checked the leave claims against old orders. Two changes had never been copied across; one name had disappeared at a fold in the paper.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R3 and grazed Cyril's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Walter Porsche of the Concord (@porsche930tt).
tangiblicious828: Quentin Tangibliciou walked into T-F3 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Quentin Tangibliciou was hit twice at T-F3, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Edmund Fedakidd of the Concord (@fedakidd). Quentin Tangibliciou stood up to fix a loose sandbag at T-F3. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Edmund Fedakidd of the Concord (@fedakidd).

Gustav Tangibliciou arrived carrying the family name of Quentin Tangibliciou. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Gustav Tangibliciou during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Gustav Tangibliciou wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.

Gustav Tangibliciou fired at a movement across the wire at T-F3. The man went down: Dietrich Wendigoarms, grazed. Gustav Tangibliciou was hit in the forearm at T-F3. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Clement William of the Concord (@william_fg9).
The medic looked at Gustav Tangibliciou's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to T-F3. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Gustav Tangibliciou hums hymns when frightened. Today, under fire at Saint-Ash crossroads, that habit was the only steady thing in T-F3.
Gustav Tangibliciou (Hegemony) and Dorian Royalcanadia (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at Calvary Farm. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
A flare caught Gustav Tangibliciou halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
A flare lit the Drowned Farm like noon. Gustav counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
thefunkmuffin16: Jakub Thefunkmuffi signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-S4 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word. Jakub Thefunkmuffi became a sniper today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

There is a sniper across the way the men call the Widow. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Widow hit all three. Jakub Thefunkmuffi watched where the shots came from. A letter from home reached Jakub Thefunkmuffi before dusk. Jakub Thefunkmuffi read it twice and slept a little easier.

Jakub Thefunkmuffi borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. A letter from home reached Jakub Thefunkmuffi before dusk. Jakub Thefunkmuffi read it twice and slept a little easier.

A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at S-S4. Jakub Thefunkmuffi saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Walter Kstoner was badly wounded. Jakub Thefunkmuffi walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Jakub Thefunkmuffi lay in the ruins of Grey Mill all day. the Widow did not fire once. Neither did Jakub Thefunkmuffi. Both of them know. A letter from home reached Jakub Thefunkmuffi before dusk. Jakub Thefunkmuffi read it twice and slept a little easier. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jakub Thefunkmuffi answered to number 486. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Jakub Thefunkmuffi wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Jakub Thefunkmuffi was promoted to Lance Corporal. The first request addressed to the new rank concerned a blocked drain.

At dusk a glint from the ridge. Jakub Thefunkmuffi fired once. The front has been quiet ever since, and nobody talks about the Widow any more. A letter from home reached Jakub Thefunkmuffi before dusk. Jakub Thefunkmuffi read it twice and slept a little easier.

Jakub Thefunkmuffi let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Walter "Parson" Roryhacon was grazed. A letter from home reached Jakub Thefunkmuffi before dusk. Jakub Thefunkmuffi read it twice and slept a little easier.

A letter reached Jakub Thefunkmuffi from Tannenfeld. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. A letter from home reached Jakub Thefunkmuffi before dusk. Jakub Thefunkmuffi read it twice and slept a little easier.

Jakub Thefunkmuffi fired once through the steel loophole at S-S4 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Henrik Roryhacon was grazed. A thin letter reached Jakub Thefunkmuffi. Only five lines long, and Jakub Thefunkmuffi knew every one of them by heart before supper.

Jakub Thefunkmuffi and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Jakub Thefunkmuffi fired. Teodor "Hollow" Jakesg was gravely wounded. Jakub Thefunkmuffi read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.

Promoted to Corporal, Jakub had to settle an argument he had been happily taking part in five minutes earlier. A letter for Jakub came all the way from home in nine days. Jakub counted them on the envelope.
tristan_j_lajambe: The old hands of M-F10 have been here since Day 1. Jonas "Button" Lajambe has been here since Day 15. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. Orders assigned Jonas "Button" Lajambe to work as a field cook. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

A borrowed pencil wore down while Jonas "Button" Lajambe was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first. Jonas "Button" Lajambe got a letter with a recipe in it. Nobody in the trench had any of the things it needed.
Jonas "Button" Lajambe kept Bram "Whistle" Joshuahudson awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Button could have walked there blind.
Jonas made soup from what the rats left. The men called it the best soup on the front, and they were not joking.
tyler_mcconne_ll: Marek "Smokes" Mcconne arrived at M-F14 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Marek "Smokes" Mcconne and Marek "Smokes" Mod argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
An empty jam tin became Marek "Smokes" Mcconne's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
Otto "Mole" Tavinnotgavi and Marek "Smokes" Mcconne split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Marek aimed just below it. Lucien Harveyjackwo was grazed.
wout.vd.weyer: Albin Weyer walked into S-F21 on Day 4 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Albin Weyer caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. A letter from home reached Albin Weyer before dusk. Albin Weyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin Weyer (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Quentin Caden (Concord) at the Chalk Pits. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge. A letter from home reached Albin Weyer before dusk. Albin Weyer read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at S-F21 changed before the cheering ended. Albin Weyer shouldered another load.

A bullet went through Albin Weyer's sleeve at S-F21 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Hugo Kitty of the Concord (@buff_kitty85). A letter from home reached Albin Weyer before dusk. Albin Weyer read it twice and slept a little easier.
Albin Weyer's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. A letter from home reached Albin Weyer before dusk. Albin Weyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin Weyer set a charge under the enemy listening post. Then he waited all night for an order that did not come. A letter from home reached Albin Weyer before dusk. Albin Weyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin Weyer borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. A letter from home reached Albin Weyer before dusk. Albin Weyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

In the dark of the Concord trench Albin Weyer hit Tobias Cpurvis with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@cpurvis_4) Albin Weyer jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp. The Concord medics will be busy. (@vitocarcioppolo) Albin Weyer joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F21 they left Albin Weyer behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Felix "Button" White of the Concord (@harry_white_y).
Nils Weyer had heard about Albin Weyer's courage. At S-F21, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Valentin Gtdigo of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at Hill 304. Nils Weyer of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it. A letter from home reached Nils Weyer before dusk. Nils Weyer read it twice and slept a little easier. Nils Weyer got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 295. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Nils Weyer helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Nils Weyer sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line. A letter from home reached Nils Weyer before dusk. Nils Weyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

A clear shot from S-F21. Nils Weyer badly wounded Otto Mihai and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home reached Nils Weyer before dusk. Nils Weyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Nils Weyer dreamt he was back in Ashford Vale, working as a coal miner. He woke up and said nothing all morning. A letter from home reached Nils Weyer before dusk. Nils Weyer read it twice and slept a little easier.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Nils Weyer gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.

Nils Weyer borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Walter "Mole" Dobremateico was badly wounded. The letter for Nils Weyer was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Nils Weyer liked the crossed-out parts best.

At S-F21 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Nils Weyer won the bet. Quentin "Hollow" Triplejjj was grazed. The runner said a letter for Nils Weyer had come up with the ammunition. Nils Weyer went to get it before the ammunition.

Nils has been given a small jar of sourdough starter by the cook, with strict instructions to keep it alive. It lives in his coat. Nils kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
